description: Calculate option Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega, rho) for individual options or an options portfolio. Uses Black-Scholes for European, binomial for American style. Paid tier only.

options.description: Array of option positions to calculate Greeks for. 1-100 options. Results include per-option Greeks and aggregated portfolio Greeks.

expiry.description: Option expiry date in ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-12-19. Must be a future date.

implied_volatility.description: Implied volatility as a decimal, e.g. 0.25 = 25%. If omitted or null, it is computed from market_price.

market_price.description: Current market price of the option in USD. Required when implied_volatility is not provided.

option_type.description: Option type: "call" gives the right to buy, "put" gives the right to sell.

quantity.description: Number of contracts. Positive = long, negative = short. Default: 1.

strike.description: Option strike price in USD. Must be a positive number.

style.description: Option exercise style. "european" can only be exercised at expiry (Black-Scholes). "american" can be exercised any time (binomial model). Default: "european".

underlying.description: Ticker symbol of the underlying asset, e.g. AAPL.

risk_free_rate.description: Annualized risk-free rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.05 = 5%. Used in Black-Scholes and binomial pricing models. Default: 0.05.

name: calculate_greeks
